title: Datasets
tsvNeedAtLeast: At least a header + 1 data row is required
emptyDescription: After creating a dataset, bind it in a case's execution settings to enable data-driven replay (N rows = N replays).
editorHint: Column names are the replay variable names ({{col}}); they must start with a letter or underscore. Sensitive columns are stored encrypted and shown as masked in reports and details. Disabled rows are skipped during replay.
disabledRowTitle: Replay skips this row when disabled

delete.title: Delete dataset
delete.rowsAlsoDeleted: {{count}} enabled rows will also be deleted
delete.rowsAlsoDeleted_one: {{count}} enabled row will also be deleted
delete.rowsAlsoDeleted_other: {{count}} enabled rows will also be deleted
delete.unbindSuffix: Cases bound to this dataset are unbound automatically (replay falls back to single execution).

tsvDescription: Copy a range in Excel/spreadsheet and paste it here: the first row is the header (column names), each remaining row is one data entry. Same-named columns are reused automatically; new columns default to non-sensitive.
